metadata.name: Diatom Composition Analysis from Sediment Core AMK75-6150
metadata.description: This dataset contains diatom composition analysis from a sediment core sample identified as AMK75-6150. It includes measurements of various diatom species and categories, sediment depth, age, and geospatial coordinates. The data is derived from a single location with varying sediment depths and ages, providing insights into diatom distribution and environmental conditions.
